records.jp: ……すでに世界は滅んでるってこと？
records.en_original: ...Then the world has already been destroyed?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Then the world has already been destroyed?
records.en: ...Then the world has already been destroyed?

records.jp: 簡単には信じられないけど……
records.en_original: That's a little hard to believe...
records.en_auxiliary: That's a little hard to believe...
records.en: That's a little hard to believe...

records.jp: 可能性の話ではあるけど……<CR>そういうことになるのかもしれない
records.en_original: It's possible that we're wrong, but...we can't rule it out.
records.en_auxiliary: It's possible that we're wrong, but...we can't rule it out.
records.en: It's possible that we're wrong, but...we can't rule it out.

records.jp: 初期化は99％完了した。でも、<CR>私たちが1％として残ってしまった。だから――
records.en_original: So the reset is 99 percent done, and we're the 1 percent that stands in the way of its completion.
records.en_auxiliary: So the reset is 99 percent done, and we're the 1 percent that stands in the way of its completion.
records.en: So the reset is 99 percent done, and we're the 1 percent that stands in the way of its completion.

records.jp: 消滅機構はわたしたちを消そうとしてるんだね……
records.en_original: And that's why the anti-virus is after us...
records.en_auxiliary: And that's why the anti-virus is after us...
records.en: And that's why the anti-virus is after us...

records.jp: もし本当にそうだとしたら、<CR>お父さんもお母さんも、友達も、みんな……
records.en_original: But if that's true, then my parents and friends are all already...?
records.en_auxiliary: But if that's true, then my parents and friends are all already...?
records.en: But if that's true, then Dad, Mom, all my friends...

records.jp: あーくそ、考えれば考えるほど息が詰まる……
records.en_original: The more I think about it, the harder it gets...
records.en_auxiliary: The more I think about it, the harder it gets...
records.en: The more I think about it, the harder it gets...

records.jp: 1％くらい見逃してくれてもいいじゃんね……
records.en_original: You'd think that 1 percent of something wouldn't be such a big deal...
records.en_auxiliary: You'd think that 1 percent of something wouldn't be such a big deal...
records.en: You'd think that 1 percent of something wouldn't be such a big deal...

records.jp: そうもいかないから「システム」なんでしょ。<CR>いや、神の考えることなんて分かんないけどさ
records.en_original: The System doesn't follow human logic, it's like trying to understand the thoughts of the gods.
records.en_auxiliary: The System doesn't follow human logic, it's like trying to understand the thoughts of the gods.
records.en: The System doesn't follow human logic, it's like trying to understand the thoughts of the gods.

records.jp: 考えたくはないけど……<CR>きららの言う話が本当である可能性は捨てきれない<CR>
records.en_original: As much as I'd hate for it to be true, we can't ignore Kirara's theory.
records.en_auxiliary: As much as I'd hate for it to be true, we can't ignore Kirara's theory.
records.en: As much as I'd hate for it to be true, we can't ignore Kirara's theory.

records.jp: だから私たちも、<CR>今まで以上にいろいろ考えていく必要があると思う
records.en_original: If it is true, we gotta be ready. Which means we have to start thinking about what to do.
records.en_auxiliary: If it is true, we gotta be ready. Which means we have to start thinking about what to do.
records.en: If it is true, we gotta be ready. Which means we have to start thinking about what to do.

records.jp: 三人に集まってもらったのも、<CR>ちょっと気になることがあったからなんだ
records.en_original: And while I have you three here, there is something I wanted to talk with you about.
records.en_auxiliary: And while I have you three here, there is something I wanted to talk with you about.
records.en: And while I have you three here, there is something I wanted to talk with you about.

records.jp: 気になること？
records.en_original: What is it?
records.en_auxiliary: What is it?
records.en: What is it?

records.jp: 勇希のこと
records.en_original: It's about Yuki.
records.en_auxiliary: It's about Yuki.
records.en: It's about Yuki.

records.jp: ほぇ？　あたし？
records.en_original: Huh? Me?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Me?
records.en: Huh? Me?

records.jp: 記憶を取り戻してないのは勇希だけ。<CR>当然、取り戻す必要があると思うんだけど……
records.en_original: You're the only one whose memories haven't returned yet, and normally, I'd say we should hurry and get them back for you, but...
records.en_auxiliary: You're the only one whose memories haven't returned yet, and normally, I'd say we should hurry and get them back for you, but...
records.en: You're the only one whose memories haven't returned yet, and normally, I'd say we should hurry and get them back for you, but...

records.jp: 勇希ってさ……ココロトープが出るの、遅くない？
records.en_original: Your Heartscape still hasn't appeared. Isn't that weird?
records.en_auxiliary: Your Heartscape still hasn't appeared. Isn't that weird?
records.en: Your Heartscape still hasn't appeared. Isn't that weird?

records.jp: ちょっと前に美弦さんに<CR>聞かれたことがあるんだよね――
records.en_original: Mio asked me about this a little while back...
records.en_auxiliary: Mio asked me about this a little while back...
records.en: Mio-san asked me about this a little while back...

records.jp: ちなみに、今はみんな記憶を取り戻せているの？
records.en_original: And has everyone recovered their memory?
records.en_auxiliary: And has everyone recovered their memory?
records.en: And has everyone recovered their memory?

records.jp: ああ、いや。勇希がまだだよ
records.en_original: Not yet. Yuki still hasn't.
records.en_auxiliary: Not yet. Yuki still hasn't.
records.en: Not yet. Yuki still hasn't.

records.jp: どうして？
records.en_original: Why is that?
records.en_auxiliary: Why is that?
records.en: Why is that?

records.jp: んー、特に理由はないんじゃないかな？<CR>単純に、まだその時が来ていないだけで……
records.en_original: Hmm... I don't know if there is a reason. Maybe it's just not time for her to remember yet.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... I don't know if there is a reason. Maybe it's just not time for her to remember yet.
records.en: Hmm... I don't know if there is a reason. Maybe it's just not time for her to remember yet.

records.jp: って、思ってたんだけど。<CR>改めて考えると、やっぱ変な感じがするんだよ
records.en_original: At least that's what I thought. But now, it does seem strange.
records.en_auxiliary: At least that's what I thought. But now, it does seem strange.
records.en: At least that's what I thought. But now, it does seem strange.

records.jp: その人の大切な思い出にまつわるものを作れば、<CR>ココロトープが出てくる可能性がある……
records.en_original: Usually a Heartscape appeared when we built something related to that person's memories.
records.en_auxiliary: Usually a Heartscape appeared when we built something related to that person's memories.
records.en: Usually a Heartscape appeared when we built something related to that person's memories.

records.jp: この考え自体は間違ってない。<CR>だとすれば、機会はけっこうあったよね？
records.en_original: But if that's true, there should have been plenty of opportunities, right?
records.en_auxiliary: But if that's true, there should have been plenty of opportunities, right?
records.en: But if that's true, there should have been plenty of opportunities, right?

records.jp: うん。勇希ちゃんはずっと<CR>学校魔改造計画って言って施設を作ろうとしてたし……
records.en_original: Yeah. Not to mention that Yuki was the one leading our school makeovers...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. Not to mention that Yuki was the one leading our school makeovers...
records.en: Yeah. Not to mention that Yuki-chan was the one leading our school makeovers...

records.jp: 勇希自身も作りたいもの、いろいろ提案してた……
records.en_original: We made plenty of things that she herself wanted to make...
records.en_auxiliary: We made plenty of things that she herself wanted to make...
records.en: We made plenty of things that she herself wanted to make...

records.jp: その中に、勇希の大切な記憶にまつわるものが<CR>一個もなかったってこと？　本当に？
records.en_original: Which would mean that she didn't have an emotional connection to even one of those things. Is that possible?
records.en_auxiliary: Which would mean that she didn't have an emotional connection to even one of those things. Is that possible?
records.en: Which would mean that she didn't have an emotional connection to even one of those things. Is that possible?

records.jp: ねえ、勇希？　そのあたり……どうかな？
records.en_original: Right, Yuki? What do you think?
records.en_auxiliary: Right, Yuki? What do you think?
records.en: Right, Yuki? What do you think?

records.jp: あたしの……記憶……？
records.en_original: My memories...?
records.en_auxiliary: My memories...?
records.en: My memories...?

records.jp: いや、ごめん。え……分かん、ない……
records.en_original: S-sorry, I just don't... What...?
records.en_auxiliary: S-sorry, I just don't... What...?
records.en: S-sorry, I just don't... What...?

records.jp: なんでだろう、あたしも……<CR>全然意識してなかった……
records.en_original: I guess I never gave it any thought...?
records.en_auxiliary: I guess I never gave it any thought...?
records.en: I guess I never gave it any thought...?

records.jp: 違う…………意識してなかったんじゃない……
records.en_original: No, that's not it... I knew.
records.en_auxiliary: No, that's not it... I knew.
records.en: No, that's not it... I knew.

records.jp: あたし……――
思い出したく、なか、った……――？
records.en_original: I didn't want to remember...
records.en_auxiliary: I didn't want to remember...
records.en: I didn't want to remember...

records.jp: ゆ、勇希ちゃん！？
records.en_original: Y-Yuki?!
records.en_auxiliary: Y-Yuki?!
records.en: Y-Yuki-chan?!

records.en_original: What is—
records.en_auxiliary: What is—
records.en: What is—

records.jp: 金城勇希さんのココロトープが出現しました
records.en_original: Yuki Kinjou's Heartscape is now connected.
records.en_auxiliary: Yuki Kinjou's Heartscape is now connected.
records.en: Kinjou Yuki-san's Heartscape is now connected.
